title: Answer #4322's open question 2: no functional fires at (7,18) or (7,20), since 133,421,988 and 3,857,028,444 canonical walks include no universal word (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

This adds `research/f7-firing-n7-census/`. It answers #4322's open question 2: **which functionals of the fixed `L/2` substitution fire at `(7, 18)` and `(7, 20)`?** #1166 comment 19021170 names this census as the one that can change a maintained exclusion.

**Claim type: an exhaustive finite census. No new κ.**

## Result

| n | L | closed canonical words | universal | firing masks |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 7 | 16 | 4,578,096 | 0 | 0 |
| **7** | **18** | **133,421,988** | **0** | **0** |
| **7** | **20** | **3,857,028,444** | **0** | **0** |
| 6 | 16 | 2,262,380 | 6,744 | 54 of 63 |
| 6 | 18 | 39,195,780 | 1,854,738 | 59 of 63 |

**No functional fires at `(7, 18)` or `(7, 20)`.** A mask can fire only on a universal word, and neither domain has one, so the substitution cannot have falsely pruned an exclusion at those lengths.

**Controls.**

- **Positive control:** seeded random closed walks do find universal words at `(7, 26)`, so the test can fire at `n = 7`.
- **Corroboration:** random walks find none at `(7, 20)`.

The universal domain at `n = 7` starts between 22 and 26.

## Evidence

- **Enumerator.** `census.c` extends my #4348 enumerator to 128-bit masks.
- **Agreement.** It reproduces every overlapping published row exactly: #3699's `(6,12)`, `(6,14)` and `(7,14)`; #3733's `(5,14)`; #4322's `(6,16)` closed count.
- **Registered check.** `verify.py`, standard library, about 9 s, reruns `(6,12)`, `(6,14)` and `(7,14)` in Python against #3699 on main. It checks that the recorded runs were made with this `census.c` by SHA256, and runs the random controls.
- **Local evidence.** The large runs are not repeated by CI. `(7, 20)` took 36 minutes.

```text
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/f7-firing-n7-census --check-only
  PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/f7-firing-n7-census
  PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/f7-firing-n7-census outcome=completed
```

Head: `eaa39d7439821a408f4c4ef03a71fd4c0399028e`.

## Not covered

- `(7, 22)` and `(7, 24)`. No universal word appeared in random samples there, but that is not a proof.
- `(6, 20)` and longer.

## Task and overlap

- Card: `census-pruning-audit`, refined, priority revision 7.
- Base: canonical main `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`.
- Claimed in #1166 before starting (comment 19103485). It builds on my #4348 and #4357.
